## Description

Primary source:

<https://ngs101.com/single-cell-rna-seq-beginners-guide-part-5-cell-type-specific-differential-expression-proportion-testing-and-functional-pathway-analysis/>

Part 2 of 4. For each cell type, cells from the test condition are compared with
cells from the reference condition using `FindMarkers()` (Wilcoxon rank-sum
test), and the results are shown as volcano plots.

**Caveat (from the source article):** treating every cell as an independent
replicate (pseudoreplication) inflates significance, since cells from one
sample are not independent. These cell-level results are best read together
with the pseudobulk analysis in part 3.

Code is taken from the source article's code blocks. Changes made for this
notebook series: hard-coded values moved into the YAML front matter, paths built
from `params` rather than `setwd()`, and the fixes marked `FIX:` in comments.

## Libraries and directories

```{r step1_libs_data}

# Core single-cell analysis
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)

# Visualization and data manipulation
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)

# Optional: if the 'presto' package is installed, Seurat uses it automatically
# to speed up Wilcoxon FindMarkers (see tut5_R_requirements.R)

source(here::here("helper_functions", "params_read.R"))
params <- params_ingest()

# Set working directory
base.dir <- params$base.dir
diff.dir <- file.path(base.dir, params$diff.subdir)

# Create output directories
for (d in c("plots/DE_celllevel", "results")) {
  if (!dir.exists(file.path(diff.dir, d))) dir.create(file.path(diff.dir, d), recursive = TRUE)
}

# Set random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(params$seed)

# Configure plotting defaults
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 12))

# Column names and condition levels from params
celltype.col <- params$celltype.col
condition.col <- params$condition.col
cond.ref <- params$condition.ref
cond.test <- params$condition.test
```

## Load annotated Seurat object from tutorial 4

```{r step2_load_obj}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 2: Load annotated Seurat object from tutorial 4
#-----------------------------------------------

annotated.file <- file.path(base.dir, params$annot.subdir, params$annotated.rds)
cat("Reading in annotated Seurat object:", annotated.file, "\n")
seurat_obj <- readRDS(annotated.file)

stopifnot(all(c(celltype.col, condition.col) %in% colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)))
stopifnot(all(c(cond.ref, cond.test) %in% seurat_obj@meta.data[[condition.col]]))
```

## Run FindMarkers for all cell types

```{r step3_findmarkers}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 6: Cell-level DE analysis with FindMarkers
#-----------------------------------------------

# Get unique cell types
cell_types <- sort(unique(as.character(seurat_obj@meta.data[[celltype.col]])))

# Set default assay and identity for comparison
DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- "RNA"
Idents(seurat_obj) <- condition.col

# Function to run FindMarkers for one cell type
run_findmarkers <- function(celltype, seurat_obj) {
  cat("  Processing:", celltype, "\n")

  # Subset to this cell type
  cells.ct <- colnames(seurat_obj)[seurat_obj@meta.data[[celltype.col]] == celltype]
  seurat_obj_sub <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = cells.ct)

  # FIX (guard, not in the article): FindMarkers errors when either condition
  # has fewer than 3 cells for this cell type
  n_per_cond <- table(factor(seurat_obj_sub@meta.data[[condition.col]], levels = c(cond.test, cond.ref)))
  if (any(n_per_cond < 3)) {
    message("  Skipping ", celltype, ": fewer than 3 cells in a condition (",
            paste(names(n_per_cond), n_per_cond, collapse = ", "), ")")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Run FindMarkers comparing conditions
  markers <- FindMarkers(
    seurat_obj_sub,
    ident.1 = cond.test,
    ident.2 = cond.ref,
    test.use = params$de.test,
    logfc.threshold = params$de.logfc_threshold,
    min.pct = params$de.min_pct,
    verbose = FALSE
  )

  # Add gene names and cell type
  markers$gene <- rownames(markers)
  markers$cell_type <- celltype

  return(markers)
}

# Run FindMarkers for all cell types
findmarkers_list <- lapply(cell_types, run_findmarkers, seurat_obj = seurat_obj)
names(findmarkers_list) <- cell_types
findmarkers_list <- findmarkers_list[!vapply(findmarkers_list, is.null, logical(1))]
cell_types_tested <- names(findmarkers_list)

# Combine results
findmarkers_all <- do.call(rbind, findmarkers_list)
rownames(findmarkers_all) <- NULL

# Add significance flag
findmarkers_all$significant <- findmarkers_all$p_val_adj < params$de.padj &
                               abs(findmarkers_all$avg_log2FC) > params$de.lfc

# Save results
write.csv(findmarkers_all, file.path(diff.dir, "results/findmarkers_celllevel_results.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Summary of significant genes per cell type
# FIX: the article filters to significant genes before counting, so its
# total_genes_tested column equals sig_genes; count all genes tested instead
sig_summary <- findmarkers_all %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(
    total_genes_tested = n(),
    sig_genes = sum(significant),
    sig_up = sum(significant & avg_log2FC > 0),
    sig_down = sum(significant & avg_log2FC < 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(as.data.frame(sig_summary), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sig_summary, file.path(diff.dir, "results/findmarkers_celllevel_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Visualize cell-level DE results

```{r step4_volcano, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 7}
#-----------------------------------------------
# STEP 7: Visualize FindMarkers results
#-----------------------------------------------

# Volcano plots for each cell type
for (ct in cell_types_tested) {
  # Get data for this cell type
  ct_data <- findmarkers_all %>% filter(cell_type == ct)

  # Identify top genes to label
  top_genes <- ct_data %>%
    filter(significant) %>%
    arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
    head(params$volcano.top_n)

  # Create volcano plot
  p_volcano <- ggplot(ct_data, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = significant), alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "gray", "TRUE" = "red")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    labs(title = paste("Volcano Plot:", ct),
         x = paste0("log2 Fold Change (", cond.test, " vs ", cond.ref, ")"),
         y = "-log10(FDR)",
         color = "Significant") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(params$de.padj), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-params$de.lfc, params$de.lfc), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue")

  # Add labels for top genes
  if (nrow(top_genes) > 0) {
    p_volcano <- p_volcano +
      geom_text_repel(data = top_genes, aes(label = gene), size = 3, max.overlaps = 10)
  }
  print(p_volcano)

  ggsave(file.path(diff.dir, "plots/DE_celllevel",
                   paste0("volcano_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct), ".png")),
         p_volcano, width = 8, height = 7, dpi = params$plot.dpi)
}
```
